description:
Advisory TTL path intent and overlap notices. Never lock, pause, or reject writes.

## Background

Shared checkout is normal. Intent is a hint, not ownership. Shell writes may be invisible. Do not claim safety. Do not create worktrees. Observing edit-tool paths is deferred.

## Matcher (one, deterministic)

- Paths are relative to the group cwd after lexical normalization (`path.normalize`, collapse `.` / `..`, POSIX-ish separators).
- Overlap is **exact match or ancestor/descendant** (a file overlaps a directory prefix).
- No glob engine, no brace expansion, no symlink-ownership claim, no filesystem lock.

## Behavior

- Announce paths + TTL; expire automatically.
- On overlap: notify live agents, name the other child’s description, suggest a direct message, surface metadata on the next real parent packet (not a spam wake).
- Continue execution.

## Success criteria

- Overlap never rejects an edit.
- Expired intent does not imply the agent stopped touching the path.

## Test plan

- Unit: `a/b.ts` overlaps `a/`; `a/b.ts` does not overlap `c/`; TTL expiry.
- Unit: no glob required (`*` is a literal path segment if announced that way).
- Logging: paths, agent ids, overlap boolean, edit still allowed.

## Considerations

Spawn children are not in the group; they do not announce.
title: Add advisory TTL path intent and overlap notices
